title: Reusable component intake rules
summary: Extract the smallest effort-saving task, declare inputs/outputs/errors/limits/effects, test boundaries and known-wrong consumers, and keep authored, tested, intake-qualified, admitted and published apart.
evidence_notes: Rules transcribed from the guide. Recorded examples keep their stated limits: motion_helpers (libfile_9da84ebd1d808191ae0300c7c98199bb) reports 48 tests but not native intake, adoption of every helper or universal compatibility; the Pymunk recovery package (libfile_98caae390d188191a2e432cf29728cff v0) has a props-only trace scope.
